opennyai_summary.facts:
The present Application has been filed by the applicant-Smt. Sushma Sharma seeking anticipatory bail in Case Crime No.71 of 2025, registered at Police Station Basant Vihar, District Dehradun under Sections 379, 420, 465, 467, 471, 504 and Section 506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2.
As per the First Information Report dated 07.04.2025, the informant's blank cheque was stolen.
The applicant forged her signature and presented it to the bank with Rs.9,50,000/-(Rupees Nine Lakh Fifty Thousand).
3.
opennyai_summary.arguments: 4. Mr. Vaibhav Singh Chauhan, Advocate, submitted that a complaint under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881 has already been filed by the applicant against the informant.
opennyai_summary.decision:
6. Time is granted.
Having heard the submissions of learned counsel for the parties and in the facts and circumstances of the case, as an ad-interim measure, it is directed that in the event of arrest of the applicant Smt. Sushma Sharma, she shall be released on interim bail on executing a personal bond of Rs.30,000/- and two reliable sureties, each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer/ Arresting Officer, subject to the following conditions:-
(i) Applicant shall cooperate with the Investigating Agency and she shall make herself available for interrogation by a police officer as and when required;
(ii) Applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of this case.
(iii) Applicant shall not leave the country without the previous permission of this Court.
